resolvedConflicts.resolution: Satisfy the reported visual defect by producing the complete official-logo-aligned silhouette and color-region layout with no visible missing slivers or seams. Preserve the existing token-derived motif palette and identity boundary; make no literal byte- or pixel-identity claim.

resolvedConflicts.issue: The two Landometer archives contain divergent JS bytes under the same v1 label.
resolvedConflicts.resolution: Use the Assets and Prompt archive because it has the later archive timestamp and the explicit source role. This is recorded as an inference, not a claimed supersession.

resolvedConflicts.issue: The attached Landometer component renders through JavaScript while LDS public-web rules require a stable final state without JavaScript.
resolvedConflicts.resolution: Generate deterministic static SVG final states from the selected runtime and render those in source HTML before progressively enhancing the one live stage.

resolvedConflicts.issue: The attached ijji CSS loops by default while ambient looping is not an approved job.
resolvedConflicts.resolution: Display static SVG by default. Inline animation only in a bounded, visible pending-state simulation and remove it when the simulated operation ends or is cancelled.

resolvedConflicts.issue: The owner requested immediate autoplay and automatic replay so viewers can inspect both Landometer full and quiet animations, while the governed production runtime and manifest motion extension remain finite_once.
resolvedConflicts.resolution: Apply the 2026-09-05 owner decision only to the user-opened preview dialog as a component-local instructional showcase. Run full and quiet together every 3000 ms only while the dialog is open, visible, motion is allowed, and the viewer has not paused. Keep the production finite-once lifecycle, snippets, manifest contract, hero, and static cards unchanged; the later logo-full geometry patch does not add a portable loop and does not apply this behavior to ijji.
